title: Transduction-Enabled Superconducting Quantum Repeater: Toward Deterministic Entanglement Distribution with High-Fidelity Gates
summary: Long-distance entanglement distribution is hindered by photon loss in optical fibers and the nocloning theorem. Optical quantum repeater (QR) protocols rely on Bell state measurements (BSMs), they are intrinsically limited to probabilistic photon operations and fail 50% of the time. We propose a hybrid approach to building quantum repeaters that combines the high transmission speed of photonic qubits in optical fiber with the high-fidelity quantum processing capabilities enabled by superconducting circuits.
